description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 05 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically amending previous regulations and detailing import control measures for specific goods. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements for import/export activities, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the primary focus is on regulatory amendments rather than government personnel or structural changes.
